purpose: Track preserved Laravel files and data while FastAPI and Next.js become authoritative.
policy: Registry entries identify preserved archive snapshots, retained live data, and deferred migrations. Never delete an entry or live data without explicit approval.

entries.reason: Tournament and rating orchestration will move to backend/app/ratings and API modules.
Club and global rating reads will move to the Python API.
Prima nota and legacy content-link helpers will be replaced by domain services or data migration code.
Blade views are replaced incrementally by the Next.js frontend after route parity is verified.
Legacy Gulp/Vue assets were removed after the Next.js frontend became authoritative.
The legacy Gulp 3 build is not used by the new frontend.
Laravel routes remain active during parallel rollout and can be retired after URL parity.
Backpack CMS/admin is outside the reduced Python scope.
Shop and payment are outside the reduced Python scope.
Shop and cart are outside the reduced Python scope.
Authentication and personal profiles are outside the reduced Python scope; preserve only if retained data references require it.
Required retained SQLite database. Never delete or recreate during parallel migration.
